title: Hardcore frozen Heart Totem of Undying
description: This resource pack changes the texture of te totem of undying to a heart one.
body:
# Hardcore Frozen Heart Totem of Undying
Take the icy theme to the next level! This pack transforms the Totem of Undying into a Hardcore Frozen Heart, combining the frozen look with the iconic hardcore-style cracked heart, giving it a dangerous and chilling edge.

### Why download it?

- Hardcore Survival Energy: The cracked icy design makes every save feel intense, dramatic, and satisfying.
- Unique Look: A perfect mix of frozen aesthetics and hardcore visual style.
- Great for Challenges: Fits perfectly in hardcore worlds, challenge servers, and winter-themed adventures.
- Lightweight & Compatible: Works smoothly with any other resource pack or shader setup.

Survive with a frosty heart that looks ready to shatter—if you don’t!

## Terms of Use

You are free to use this resource pack in Minecraft, your videos, and your modpacks.

If you include it in a modpack or showcase it in a video, I would appreciate it if you add a link to this page in the description.

_**Do not redistribute or claim the pack as your own.**_
